summary: NEDSTRAND BÅTFORENING (org. no. 986 203 427) is an association (FLI) based in Tysvær, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2003-11-20. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 94.992 (Aktiviteter i andre medlemsorganisasjoner ellers). Board chair: Tor Øiseth.

gaps.reason: Legal form FLI is normally not required to file annual accounts in Norway, so none are public.
No LEI is registered with GLEIF for this organisation number (common for companies without traded securities or large financial contracts).
No CEO (daglig leder) is registered; this is optional for many legal forms.
No verified Wikidata item links to this number (normal for smaller companies).
